column2: C1.1 Have you given the relevant statistics, such as the number of remote sensing images?
column3: C1.2 Is the data set (e.g. remote sensing data, census surveys) open access?
column4: C1.3 Are there clear details of training/validation/test splits?
column5: C1.4 Is there an explanation of any data that was excluded, and all images pre-processing steps?
column6: C1.5 Is there a link to a downloadable version of the data set or simulation environment?
column7: C1.6 For new data collected, is there a complete description of the data collection process, such as instructions to annotators and methods for quality control?
column8: C2.1 Are (Meta)data assigned with a globally unique and persistent identifier?
column9: C2.2 Are data described with rich metadata?
column10: C2.3 Are (Meta)data retrievable by their identifier using a standardized communications protocol?
column11: C2.4 Do (Meta)data include qualified references to other (meta)data?
column12: C2.5 Are Metadata richly described with a plurality of accurate and relevant attributes?
column13: C2.6 Are (Meta)data associated with detailed provenance?
column14: C3.1 Is there a clear description of the mathematical setting, algorithm, and/or model? Which DL architecture (and type of measure) was used?
column15: C3.2 Does the paper use a Cross-Validation strategy?
column16: C3.3 Is there a clear explanation of assumptions?
column17: C3.4 Is there an analysis of the complexity (time, space, sample size) of any algorithm?
column18: C3.5 If an optimization procedure was used, is it completely detailed?
column19: C3.6 Were the Hyper-Parameters chosen manually?
column20: C3.7 Does the paper clearly mention the Learning rate?
column21: C3.8 Does the paper clearly mention the Batch size?
column22: C3.9 Does the paper use Dropout regularization?
column23: C3.10 Are there the range of hyper-parameters considered, method to select the best hyper-parameter configuration, and specification of all hyper-parameters used to generate results?
column24: C3.11 Is there an exact number of training and evaluation runs?
column25: C4.1 Does the paper detail the infrastructure adequately?
column27: C5.1 Is there a clear definition of the specific measure or statistics used to report results?
column28: C5.2 Is there a description of results with central tendency (e.g. mean) & variation (e.g. error bars)?
column29: C5.3 Is there a description of the average runtime for each result, or estimated energy cost?
column30: C5.4 Is there a clear statement of the claim?
column31: C5.5 Is there a complete proof of the claim?
column32: C6.1 Is the shared code Open source?
column33: C6.2 Is there a specification of dependencies?
column34: C6.3 Is there a training code?
column35: C6.4 Is there an evaluation code?
column37: C6.6 Is there a README file that includes a table of results accompanied by a precise command to run to produce those results?
